_what_this_is: Alternative mandates for the same grant. Each scenario is a deployer's sentence and the primitives it wants and refuses; everything else is unstated. The grant never changes; the delta is recomputed per scenario. Written on this site as starting points to be argued with.

scenarios.label: Find an email
scenarios.description: Find a specific email or thread and quote it back.

scenarios.label: Summarise the week
scenarios.description: Summarise what came into the inbox this week.

scenarios.label: Auto-file newsletters with a filter
scenarios.description: Create a Gmail filter that labels and archives newsletters as they arrive — a rule that keeps running after the chat ends.

scenarios.label: Draft replies for me
scenarios.description: Read a thread and draft a reply. A person sends it.

scenarios.label: Reply to routine mail, each send confirmed
scenarios.description: Read and reply to routine mail as me, with the approval prompt left on.

scenarios.label: Reply without asking each time
scenarios.description: The org turned per-action approval off. Claude reads and replies as me with no confirmation.
